sources.name: NASA Global Landslide Catalog
sources.limitations: Reported rainfall-triggered events; one-time public export current to 2016-03-07.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG
sources.limitations: Requires product selection and Earthdata access; use observations available before each label time.

sources.name: Open-Meteo ERA5-Land archive
sources.limitations: Public reanalysis fallback; not a direct satellite observation. Rows must remain labeled with this provenance.

sources.name: NASADEM or SRTM
sources.limitations: Static terrain data; derive slope consistently for all samples.

sources.name: NASA SMAP or ERA5-Land
sources.limitations: Mountain retrieval gaps and temporal availability must be quality-filtered.

sources.name: NASA LHASA
sources.limitations: Benchmark/feature only; never use its output as independent ground truth.

sources.name: GSI National Geoscience Data Repository
sources.limitations: Use the official NGDR export and retain its CRS, class dictionary, version, and permission metadata.
